title: Suppression Is Not Forgetting: Residual Recoverability in Visual Concept Unlearning for VLMs
abstract: arXiv:2604.03114v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) may need to forget visual concepts after deployment because of privacy, copyright, licensing, safety, or policy changes. Conventional machine unlearning modifies model parameters, which may be costly or inaccessible for API-only models. Prompt-based suppression offers a training-free alternative, but does it make a concept inaccessible or merely change the model's answer?   We investigate this question in off-the-shelf VLMs. Our visually grounded, multi-probe evaluation first verifies that a model recognizes each concept from the image, then tests its recoverability through multiple-choice, short-answer, and indirect queries. Across objects, scenes, and identities, prompt suppression reduces short-answer recall for some concepts while leaving multiple-choice and indirect performance largely unchanged. translated_title: 抑制并非遗忘：视觉语言模型视觉概念去学习中的残余可恢复性
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）在部署后可能因隐私、版权、许可协议、安全性或政策变更等原因需要遗忘某些视觉概念。传统的机器遗忘方法需要修改模型参数，这对于仅通过API访问的模型而言可能成本高昂或根本不可行。基于提示词的抑制（prompt-based suppression）提供了一种无需训练的替代方案，但它究竟使概念变得真正不可访问，还是仅仅改变了模型的回答？我们在现成的VLMs中研究了这一问题。我们提出的基于视觉、多探针的评估方法首先验证模型能够从图像中识别出每个概念，然后通过多选题、简答题和间接查询来测试其可恢复性。在物体、场景和身份等概念上，提示词抑制降低了某些概念的简答题回忆率，但多选题和间接查询的性能基本保持不变。明确列出需要抑制的概念往往会提高简答题的回忆率，这表明……
tldr: 研究发现，基于提示词的抑制并不能真正让视觉语言模型“遗忘”视觉概念——被抑制的概念仍可通过多选题和间接查询恢复，说明抑制只是改变了模型的表层回答，而非真正抹除了模型的知识。
en_tdlr: Prompt-based suppression in VLMs does not truly erase visual concepts—suppressed knowledge remains recoverable through multiple-choice and indirect probing, revealing that suppression merely alters answers rather than inducing genuine forgetting.
